status: accepted; fifteen distinct authored poses with native-render separate-ball track review passed
prompt: Isolated transparent PNG, NO background. One right-facing pose of original character Keeg K.03: adult athletic human man, black hair, neat close beard, exceptionally tall ornate purple witch hat with silver trim and small mushrooms, purple/lavender/silver Moonmorel Hex uniform and shoes. Crisp 1990s pixel arcade style. Pose for frame 0 of a reverse alley-oop dunk: compact forward approach step to the right, chin/eyes tracking upward, elbows bent and held close, empty hands loosely raised at chest level with clear gap, knees flexed. Natural anatomy with exactly two arms and legs, complete hat and feet. Fit entire silhouette within the middle 65% of a 1024x1536 portrait canvas, centered, leaving large empty transparent border around it; silhouette aspect ratio no wider than 0.75. TRUE TRANSPARENCY: every pixel outside the character must have alpha 0. Do NOT draw any checkerboard, gray tiles, white or colored backdrop, transparency preview, backdrop pattern, floor, shadow, ground, court, hoop, ball, object, glow, border, text, logo or grid. Return one character only with a genuinely transparent background.
sourcePromptStatus: verbatim pose00 prompt; exact per-pose source/edit prompts are linked in sourceRecords
ballPolicy: The basketball is a separate Keeg-specific runtime object. Source poses contain no ball. The incoming lob meets the empty catch gap at pose05/tick10. Keeg carries it behind the hip/hat, then releases it at pose10/tick21 into simulation-owned rim flight.
